doc_friction.issue: For git-history studies it suggests `git fetch --unshallow` (2 to 15 min, up to 5 GB). `git fetch --unshallow --filter=blob:none origin main` took 23 s and 1.3 GB, and a batched `--stdin` fetch of the blob ids a study needs makes blame fast. Worth saying there, along with the warning that lazy per-blob fetches are slow.
